sections.heading: Who can become a Creator?
sections.text:
AVIATION IS YOUR DOMAIN

Who can become a Creator?

Bring genuine aviation experience, a course idea and a willingness to teach responsibly.

Confirm you are 18 or older and legally able to enter the Creator agreement.
At least 24 months of aviation experience under the current published policy.
A public professional-profile HTTPS link is required.
Your professional and teaching categories must be open for onboarding.
Provide a course idea and accept the accuracy, expertise and audience declarations.
Pilot / Flight Crew
Cabin Crew
Aircraft Maintenance / Engineering
Ground Operations
Airport Operations
Aviation Safety / Quality
Aviation Security
Flight Operations
Aviation Management
Aviation Hospitality / Customer Experience
Aviation Trainer / Instructor
Aviation Recruitment / Career
Drone / UAV
Defence Aviation
Other Aviation Professional

Passing eligibility does not activate Creator access or guarantee approval of a course proposal.

sections.heading: A considered path to creating.
sections.text:
FROM IDEA TO PRIVATE LESSONS

A considered path to creating.
01
Account & eligibility

Use your normal AirBharath account and complete the current eligibility check.

02
Your access path

When purchases are enabled, paid membership requires a verified email and acceptance of current Creator Terms and Refund Policy. An authorized Admin-issued complimentary grant follows its separate eligibility and Creator Terms requirements.

03
Creator Profile

After authorized access, save your professional background and teaching focus.

04
Course proposal

Prepare the course title, intended learners, learning objectives and outline.

05
AirBharath review

Submit for review. Respond to requested changes; approval is not guaranteed.

06
Approved private builder

After proposal approval, develop private modules and text lessons. No publication or selling during Early Access.

AirBharath review is a platform quality review, not DGCA, airline, government or regulatory approval. Creators bring their own audience; learners, promotion, sales and revenue are not guaranteed.
